Forms are removed when remove_forms is true

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<p>Before</p><form><input type='text'/><button>Submit</button></form><p>After</p>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"preprocessing":{"remove_forms":true}}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
